left.label: Context panel
media.title: Media
media.dragHint: Drag to the timeline · double-click to preview
media.noneHint: Import from your PotionUI library or gallery, from this computer, or drop files here.
media.useAsFrame: Use as frame at the playhead
dock.title: Director IA
dock.settingsTip: Engine, profile, quality and drafts of the project
dock.guide.title: What guides the generation
dock.mode.fl2va: Continuity between the start and end images.
dock.mode.ref2va: Keep the identity of the references during the action.
dock.mode.hybrid: The soundtrack, rhythm and dialogue drive the picture.
dock.refs.intro: What must stay the same from one shot to the next: global references go with every generation, the others only apply to their range.
dock.refs.dragHint: Drag a thumbnail onto the Frames track to anchor it to a precise moment.
dock.results.emptyHint: Pick a target in the Production bar, then run “Generate selection”.
story.title: Storyboard
story.placeholder: Tell the film in a few sentences: each sentence becomes a shot.
story.proposeTip: Sentence split; ask the assistant for a real breakdown
story.sequenceHint: Choose “Sequence” in the Production bar to generate everything at once.
story.allDone: Every shot is final or comes from a source.
story.noShots: No shots yet: write the synopsis and propose a breakdown, or add a shot in the Storyboard.
story.continuityOk: Color and identity matches are consistent.
story.continuityNone: No match to check yet: the shots have no image.
scene.title: 3D scene
scene.renderTip: Renders the 3D shot frame by frame at 24 fps; the video joins the shot as its camera reference.
mixer.title: Mix
scene.stale: The camera path changed: render the reference video again.
scene.ends: Use start and end as first and last frames
scene.endsWorking: Capturing the start and the end…
scene.endsTip: Captures the camera at the start and at the end of the path and places them as the first and last frames of the shot. This works today with FL2VA on 12 GB.
scene.holesWarn: Beyond 15° or 25 %, one picture leaves holes in the view: they are likely here.
scene.presetHint: A scene built from one picture holds about ±10° of camera movement.
scene.presetHintGlb: Around the center of the Blender scene, from the current camera.
scene.short: Shorter than {min}: the reference video will be too short for MiniMax.
scene.noPlan: Select a 3D shot, or put the playhead in one, to render it.
scene.size: Reference video: {width} × {height}, {fps} fps (long side capped at {max} px)
dock.engine.title: Engine
dock.engine.hint: These settings apply to every shot that does not set its own in its shot editor. The default quality is the one the Production bar takes when the project opens.
queue.title: Generation queue
queue.slotsTip: Takes handed to the engine, out of how many of your takes may run at once.
queue.elsewhere.one: {count} more take of yours is in the queue for another project: all your projects share one queue.
queue.elsewhere.other: {count} more takes of yours are in the queue for other projects: all your projects share one queue.
queue.emptyHint: The takes waiting for the engine or running on it show here, in the order they run.
queue.prioritize: Move take {variant} to the head of the queue
queue.prioritizeTip: Move to the head of the queue
queue.prioritizeNo: Already first, or already handed to the engine
dock.engine.marginUnit: seconds before and after the shot
dock.engine.marginHint: Widens the part of a reference track that guides MiniMax H3. A track mixed onto the take is always cut to the shot.
